messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — Saffron private/VPC deploy window is set for Thu Mar 26 02:00-04:00 UTC. This is config + model rollout (model v2.3.1 -> v2.3.2) and one egress rule change. Who can own the deploy and the immediate smoke checks? Also need a rollback owner and someone to watch latency for the first 15m.

ashok: I can take the deploy. I'll be on-call during that window. Will run the preflight and kick off the pipeline. :thumbsup:

lucy: I'll own smoke tests and quick quality checks. Plan: run canary route (10% traffic) for 10m then ramp. I'll validate embeddings and a few key prompts. :eyes:

sam: I'll be rollback lead / fallback ops. If latency >200ms p50 for 5 consecutive minutes or error rate >2% I'll initiate rollback. Have rollback job ready.

maria: Awesome — can you paste the exact commands you'll run so we have them in the runbook? Also note: customer requires that we capture packet logs during the window (they've signed the intake form).

ashok: Preflight commands I'll run: `./infra/checks/preflight.sh --env saffron-vpc` and then manual s3 config validation. Deploy pipeline is `ci/deploy-redwood:deploy --env saffron-vpc --image redwood/inference:v2.3.2`

ashok: CI status (20:44 UTC): devops-bot: pipeline passed unit + e2e, infra checks pending.

devops-bot: build/2001 passed, e2e/2001 passed, infra/2001 pending. Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/2001 :white_check_mark:

lucy: Smoke checklist (short):
- sanity: `curl -sS https://saffron.private/api/health` expect 200
- latency probe: run `scripts/latency_probe --target saffron-vpc --duration 600`
- model sanity: run three sample prompts from benchmarks/saffron_prompts.json and compare hashes

sam: Rollback quick command (keeps nodes, rolls image back):
```
kubectl set image deploy/redwood-infer inference=redwood/inference:v2.3.1 -n saffron
kubectl rollout status deploy/redwood-infer -n saffron
```

maria: Nice. Can we add a quick smoke dashboard link and a Slack alert channel? Lucy — can you add `#saffron-deploy-monitor` for the window and configure alerts for p50/p95 and error rate?

lucy: Done — added channel and alert hooks. I'll post the dashboard link before hand.

ashok: One more thing: network team wants a 5-min blackout at 02:30 to flip an egress ACL. I'll coordinate — plan is to pause the canary traffic for that 5m window, then resume. If anything looks off we'll abort and rollback.

maria: OK — timeline recap: 02:00 preflight, 02:10 canary deploy (10% traffic), 02:30 short egress ACL flip (5m) — pause canary during that time, 02:40 resume and monitor, 02:50 decision point to full ramp or rollback. Owners: deploy=ashok, smoke=lucy, rollback=sam. Everyone OK? :white_check_mark:

ashok: OK for me.

lucy: OK.

sam: I'll be on standby. Logging my pager info in the runbook.

maria: Thanks — I'll update the change window doc and drop the runbook link here before EOD. If anything changes ping in this thread.
